benefits_summary: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining age 60 for unorganized workers (rickshaw pullers, street vendors, construction workers, domestic workers) with 50% government co-contribution.
exclusions: Workers covered under EPFO, ESIC, or NPS
documents_required: Savings Bank Account Passbook with IFSC
application_steps: Visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with your bank passbook.
Complete biometric verification and pay the first monthly contribution in cash.
Receive your printed PM-SYM Pension Card immediately.
